ResourceMiner.name: submit_action_bundle
ResourceMiner.condition: Stamina budget available for action creation
ResourceMiner.description: Agent prepares and submits an action bundle containing claims, raids, defense commitments, and mining allocations for the current round. This action is the initial step in the decision-making process, triggered by the system start event.

required_variables.name: agent_id
required_variables.description: Unique identifier of the agent submitting the action bundle

required_variables.name: stamina_budget
required_variables.description: Agent's stamina budget for the current round

output_updates.name: action_bundle
output_updates.description: JSON object containing claims, raids, defense commitments, and mining allocations

ResourceMiner.name: validate_and_clip
ResourceMiner.condition: Action bundle contains valid claim/raid/defense/mining components
ResourceMiner.description: Validates the submitted action bundle against legality constraints and clips it to ensure it adheres to the agent's stamina budget. This action processes the bundle to remove illegal actions and prioritize valid ones according to the agent's specified order.

required_variables.name: action_bundle
required_variables.description: Action bundle submitted by the agent for validation and clipping

required_variables.name: stamina_budget
required_variables.description: Agent's stamina budget for the current round

required_variables.name: priority_order
required_variables.description: Agent-specified priority order for action clipping (e.g., Mining → Raids → Claims → Defense)

output_updates.name: validated_actions
output_updates.description: Action bundle after legality checks and budget clipping

output_updates.name: stamina_used
output_updates.description: Total stamina consumed by validated actions

output_updates.name: illegal_actions
output_updates.description: List of illegal actions removed from the bundle

ResourceMiner.name: resolve_claims
ResourceMiner.condition: Unowned plots exist for claim resolution
ResourceMiner.description: Resolves claims on unowned plots using deterministic hash-based tie-breaking. This action determines ownership transfers for unclaimed plots based on the submitted action bundle and the current ownership state.

required_variables.name: ownership_grid
required_variables.description: Current state of plot ownership across the 2×2 grid

required_variables.name: event_log
required_variables.description: Previous round's event log for conflict resolution context

required_variables.name: validated_actions
required_variables.description: Action bundle after validation and clipping

output_updates.name: claimed_plots
output_updates.description: List of unowned plots with resolved ownership

output_updates.name: tie_breaker_hash
output_updates.description: SHA-256 hash used for deterministic tie-breaking

ResourceMiner.name: resolve_raids
ResourceMiner.condition: Owned plots exist for raid resolution
ResourceMiner.description: Resolves raid outcomes on owned plots by applying precommitted defense commitments and determining winners via hash-based tie-breaking. This action determines which agents retain or lose ownership of contested plots.

required_variables.name: ownership_grid
required_variables.description: Current state of plot ownership after claim resolution

required_variables.name: validated_actions
required_variables.description: Action bundle after validation and clipping

required_variables.name: defense_commitments
required_variables.description: Binary defense commitments on self-owned plots

output_updates.name: raided_plots
output_updates.description: List of plots with raid outcomes and involved agents

output_updates.name: stamina_used_raids
output_updates.description: Total stamina consumed by raid actions

ResourceMiner.name: apply_mining
ResourceMiner.description: Applies mining output to plots based on post-conflict ownership and stamina allocations. This action calculates gold extraction for each plot, respecting the per-plot productivity cap and updating the agent's cumulative gold reserves.

required_variables.name: ownership_grid
required_variables.description: Final state of plot ownership after conflict resolution

required_variables.name: validated_actions
required_variables.description: Action bundle after validation and clipping

required_variables.name: s_max
required_variables.description: Maximum gold yield per plot per round

output_updates.name: gold_mined
output_updates.description: Gold extracted from the plot (min(stamina_allocated, s_max))

output_updates.name: total_gold
output_updates.description: Agent's cumulative gold reserves after mining
